🏭 New research from the Global Carbon Project has found that carbon emissions from fossil fuels are projected to decrease by 0.4% in 2026 – driven by the expansion of solar and wind power and the Iran conflict. The report found that emissions from oil are projected to decrease by 1.9% – likely a short-term response to the energy shock triggered by the Iran conflict. The report also found that while solar, wind power, and electric vehicles are growing in use, clean energy growth is not yet fast enough for a durable decline in global fossil CO2 emissions. Emissions from Australia were down 1.2% in 2025, while NZ emissions dropped 1%.
🗨️Experts from CSIRO, Macquarie University, UTS Science, Adelaide University, and Monash University have responded to the results.
